issues.description: The template header declares the sphere-intersection function as check_sphere_hit(...) while the implementation and all usages expect ray_sphere_intersect(...). The solution repository consistently uses ray_sphere_intersect(...). This naming mismatch in the template (declaration vs. implementation/usage) creates a direct mapping and compilation problem: students including the header will not find a matching declaration for ray_sphere_intersect, causing build errors and confusion about which function name to implement or call.
issues.suggested_fix: In the template header (template_repository/example_program/src/ray_sphere_intersect.h) rename the declaration check_sphere_hit(...) to ray_sphere_intersect(...) with the same signature so it matches the implementation and usages (and aligns with the solution). This removes ambiguity and prevents compilation/lookup errors. Example: replace 'bool check_sphere_hit(...);' with 'bool ray_sphere_intersect(...);'.
